params.caption: 🕹️ PlayStation wins the £2 billion UK lawsuit over PS Store prices Sony has defeated a UK class action that claimed it forced players into "excessive and unfair prices" on the PlayStation Store. The ruling came after a 30-day hearing at the Competition Appeal Tribunal in London. The claim was worth about $2.6 billion, and the result means Sony will not be compelled to allow third-party stores on its consoles. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 19:08 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: VGC · Eurogamer 👥 @PlayStation ⚖️ Good or bad for players?
